_design_note: M4 anchor. First arm of the spatial line and the base every later increment is measured against: board_egocentric_v2 (seven agent-centred planes plus six scalars), a CNN whose only downsample is its last convolution, Double DQN with a target network, n=3, D4 augmentation, and E07. E07 rather than the E02 family because every E00-E06 schedule starts epsilon at 0.30, which was never a problem for a handcrafted-feature model but is one here: an untrained CNN's argmax is near-constant across states, so 0.30 would leave 70 percent of steps executing one fixed action. Double DQN, dueling's absence, D4 and n=3 are a bundle, not an attribution -- the anchor is a base, and the single-factor arms are the ones measured against it. Because E07 counts its hold and anneal in absolute rounds, the checkpoint at round N of this run is exactly what a run budgeted at N rounds would have produced, so this one arm answers the budget question at every checkpoint and no separate budget arm is needed.

_predeclared_design_numbers.budget_curve: docs/05 section 0.18 found that on the handcrafted line, training past 2000 rounds made the competition-setting score worse twice over. Whether that holds here is open; report the classic_versus_opponents score at every evaluated checkpoint rather than only at the end.
_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: Everything. This is the M4 base, not a single-factor comparison.
_predeclared_design_numbers.gate: Must learn from scratch: the loot-crate holdout score must rise monotonically over the first checkpoints and end clearly above a random policy. If it does not, stop and diagnose the anchor -- do not add increments to a base that does not learn.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: None stated for the comparison against M3. The handcrafted line reached 32.6 at 2000 rounds on 62 hand-designed dimensions; this line sees 2029 raw ones and has to learn what those dimensions already encode, so a slower start is expected and says nothing about the ceiling.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: Report all five training-seed distributions, every G2 threshold, and coins_share alongside score for every arm that has opponents.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_loot_crate: docs/01 section 7.21: the five-seed spread of the handcrafted control gives sd 3.77, so two arms measured once each need a gap of 4.7 before a direction may be read into it.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: docs/01 section 7.20: pooled 450-round classic-with-opponents score has sd 0.089, so two arms need a gap of 0.246 (coins_share: 0.022).
